name: Hackman Microfinance Bank
notes: Live site returns HTTP 500. Header logo (228x87, 'HMB Hackman Microfinance Bank' with hands/people emblem) from Wayback snapshot 2019-04-02. name: Kano Poly Microfinance Bank
notes: NOT FOUND. kanopolymfb.ng unreachable; CBN revoked its licence effective 1 July 2026. Wayback has homepage snapshots 2023-2024 whose header uses img/logo3.jpg, but that image (and favicon) was never archived (404 at every timestamp; CDX shows no images). No Apple or Google Play app; no official Facebook page found (graph lookup 'kanopolymfb' does not exist).

name: Movasco Microfinance Bank
notes: LOW-MEDIUM confidence. Circular seal 'MOUAU VASMUCS Microfinance Bank Ltd' (220x220) from Wayback 2022-09-23 of mouauvasmucsmfb.com (live site unreachable). Movasco-op MFB (Umudike, Abia) is the successor of Mouau Vasmucs MFB following an NDIC purchase-and-assumption (2026 reports); this is the predecessor's last official logo, and Movasco may have rebranded. Distinct from MOUAU MFB (mouaumfb.com). No app found on Apple/Google Play.
